thesis: This run successfully opened long positions on three top picks from the Quality Matrix, leveraging strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. The focus was on GR Silver Mining Ltd. (GRSL.V), A2 Gold Corp. (AUAU.V), and NorthIsle Copper and Gold Inc. (NCX.V), each selected for their strong potential based on the matrix scoring. The churn guard was bypassed due to the compelling composite scores and drilling results, ensuring that these high-potential assets are part of the portfolio.
